remarks: HIGHEST and BEST due Monday 10/27 at 5 pm.Picture perfect inside and out. Enjoy your morning coffee overlooking an idyllic pond from your living room balcony. The white oak hardwood floors are new as is the carpeting in all of the bedrooms. The lower level has an additional 650 sq ft that is easily finished and opens to your private garage. Have it all, a stone's throw from town and trails. Pool and tennis court on the property! You will love living here!
